newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes steady against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished mostly steady at 42.5485/5495 to the dollar in interbank trading, against the previous 42.5490/5495, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5480/95 per dollar in early trade but eased later on the active presence of importers.
"But there were sellers (of dollars) too. Most deals were done at 42.5490 level," said one dealer with a private bank.
The call money was traded at 5.25 percent to 6.0 percent, slightly up from Monday's 5.0-5.75 percent, dealers said.
